Beginning
Holy Fuel Week! Fuel-Electric System added! (still working on it to work properly). To be honest, I couldn't work on the No Gasoline like the previous weeks. It is caused of several reasons including my little sickness. 


What I Did Last Week?
Let's get back on the No Gasoline:

+ Now motors, hinges etc. requires fuel DONE
+ Fuel can be stored. DONE
+ Filling animation DONE
+ Some bug fixes & improvements on features that I added in the previous weeks.


Next Week?
Next week I will be working on bug fixes and similar stuff and rest a little bit.

Take care of yourselves people!

notes.title: Time To Make Building Mechanic Better Stronger Faster
notes.content:
Beginning
Well, It's been a rough week actually. First, I was rushing to get the No Gasoline's steam page ready to festival. Then I needed to work on social media and marketing side (to be honest due to my lack of experience I haven't done something important but better than nothing). 

I can't count how many times I remade the steam page. It still not perfect but I'm working on it. In two months, I will make a major update to steam page based on the experiences I've gained.

What I Did Last Week?

Mostly, I have worked on Steam Page and trailer but also I added a cool split screen mechanic that allows player to switch between split-screen and single camera mode. It will also seperate the camera automatically if the players get too far apart.

What I'm Doing This Week?
After spending the last weeks away from the development side. Now I will be focusing back on that!

Mainly I will working Building system this week. But it can be split on four header.
1) Premium Deluxe Update On Connection System. (This will allow for creation of more bigger complexer and better vehicles)
2) Awsome Enchance On Moveable Parts. (I was using a basic method to handle moving parts but it wasn't working well. So, I'll be converting them to rigid bodies for more realistic physics.)
3)Hyper Realistic Wheel Physics.(If time allows) (I also used a basic method for this, and I'd like to improve it this week but it will be done in two weeks.)

Sadly, these are more back-end tasks but I'll try to keep you updated! 

My Thoughts & Summarise
Actually, I think I have said that everything I want to say. Take of yourselves. 

Until next time!
